title: com.docker.sandbox/gpu@1
description: Config schema for the gpu need: GPUs of one driver, the GPU interface the image is built for, and how many. Permission surface. Singleton. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move and the maintainer-approved draft-stage exception.

driver.description: <dns-domain>/<name>. The page documents nvidia.com/gpu and mesa3d.org/venus; any other name is runtime-defined. The domain is at most 253 characters and the name at most 63.

devices.description: "all" (every GPU of the driver, and at least one) or a positive count. Omission or an empty string is equivalent to "all".
